# GitHub Discussions & Community Taxonomy

Enable **GitHub Discussions** under `Settings -> Features -> Discussions` with the following categories:

| Category | Format | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Announcements** | Announcement (Maintainers only) | Release notes, security advisories, roadmap milestones |
| **Q&A & Support** | Question / Answer | Self-hosting troubleshooting, Ollama/vLLM setup, API usage |
| **Ideas & Roadmap** | Open-ended | Feature proposals, model benchmarks, competitor gap suggestions |
| **Show & Tell** | Open-ended | Custom plugins, LTI 1.3 university setups, MCP workflows |
| **General** | Open-ended | Community introductions and open-source governance |
